guide.title: App registration in Entra ID
guide.description: Steps for IT and for whoever runs the platform. Done once per environment (QA and PRD).

register.title: Create the registration
register.intro: In the Microsoft Entra portal, App registrations, New registration.
steps: Name: SAPExtract QA or SAPExtract PRD, depending on the environment.
Supported account types: accounts in this organizational directory only.
Redirect URI: Web platform, with the URI shown on the configuration screen.
Under Authentication, leave the implicit flow tokens and «Allow public client flows» unchecked.
Copy the directory (tenant) ID and the application (client) ID from the overview page.

credential.title: Create the credential
credential.intro: Under Certificates & secrets. A certificate is the recommended option.
steps: Certificate: generate it on a trusted machine with the command below and upload only the .crt file to the registration.
Paste the .crt and the .key into the platform, save, and delete the key from the machine.
Client secret, if there is no certificate: New client secret expiring in 12 months. Copy the value right away and note the expiry date.
Never send the key or the secret by email or chat: load them here directly.
credential.commandIntro: 3072-bit RSA certificate valid for one year:
credential.command: openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:3072 -sha256 -days 365 -nodes -keyout sapextract.key -out sapextract.crt -subj "/CN=SAPExtract PRD"

groups.title: Send groups in the token
groups.intro: Under Token configuration, Add groups claim.
steps: In the ID token, as group ID.
Copy each group's object ID (Groups, the group, Overview) into the groups and roles table.
If someone belongs to more than 200 groups, the token does not include them all: the GroupMember.Read.All permission will be needed.

permissions.title: API permissions
permissions.intro: Under API permissions, Microsoft Graph, delegated permissions.
steps: Only if users have more than 200 groups: GroupMember.Read.All, with admin consent.

activate.title: Test and enable
activate.intro: Back in the platform, on the configuration screen.
steps: Save the IDs and the credential.
Select Test configuration: it checks the tenant, the signing keys and that Entra accepts the client ID and the credential.
The redirect URI and the groups are only checked on the first real sign-in.
Map groups to roles and enable Entra ID.

pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.description: Each pipeline moves one SAP source into one destination. Create, activate and run them manually here.
pipelines.emptyFirst: Create the first one with an active SAP source and destination.

form.title: New pipeline
form.description: Choose the source, the destination and how it loads. It is saved as a draft: activate it to run it.
form.codeHint: 3 to 40 characters: letters, digits and underscore.
form.targetHint: Snowflake table or CSV folder. If empty: system_source.

modeHint.ODQ: The source has ODQ delta: the first run initializes the subscription.
modeHint.WATERMARK: The source uses a watermark: each run reads the changes since the previous one.
modeHint.NONE: The source has no delta: full load only.

form.appendOnlyHint: The source does not deliver after images: append only.
form.deltaNotice: Until SAP confirms that two subscriptions can coexist, there can be only one delta pipeline per entity set.

detail.noRuns: No runs yet. Use “Run now” to start the first one.
detail.closePending: The previous subscription may still be open in ODQMON. Close it there and confirm, or declare that you leave it open, before initializing again.
detail.filtersChanged: The filters changed since the initialization: reset the delta to run again.
detail.draftBanner: Draft: activate it to run it. Activation checks the SAP system, the destination and the load settings.

reset.title: Reset the delta of {{code}}
reset.message: The next run performs a full initialization. The current subscription stays pending closure in ODQMON.

closed.title: Confirm closure in SAP
closed.message: Confirm that you deleted the previous subscription in ODQMON. Then the delta can be initialized again.

left_open.title: Leave the previous subscription open
left_open.message: The previous subscription queue keeps growing in SAP. Say why you leave it open.

delete.title: Delete {{code}}
delete.message: The pipeline stops running. If it had a delta, its subscription stays pending closure in SAP.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Run history of every pipeline, with status and rows.

detail.cancelMessage: The worker stops between pages and the token does not move. Anything loaded but not confirmed is repeated by the next run without duplicates.
detail.retryAt: An attempt failed: it will retry from {{when}}.
detail.live: Refreshes every second while the run is in progress.
detail.noSteps: No steps yet: the run is queued.
detail.noAttempts: No worker has taken it yet.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Extraction health at a glance: refreshes itself every few seconds.

timeline.title: Timeline of the last 24 hours
timeline.empty: No runs in the last 24 hours.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Incidents found by the rules: one notice when they open and another when they recover.
alerts.resolveMessage: If the problem persists, the next evaluation opens another alert (without notifying again).

run_failed.label: Failed run
run_failed.description: The pipeline's last run failed after exhausting retries.

delta_broken.label: Broken delta
delta_broken.description: SAP rejected the delta token: it must be reset.

freshness.label: Stale data
freshness.description: No successful load within the given time.

duration_anomaly.label: Unusual duration
duration_anomaly.description: The last run took several times the usual.

volume_anomaly.label: Unusual volume
volume_anomaly.description: Several incremental loads in a row without rows.

stale_subscription.label: Stale subscription
stale_subscription.description: No confirmed delta read for several days: the queue grows in SAP.

unclosed_subscription.label: Unclosed subscription
unclosed_subscription.description: A previous subscription is still pending closure in ODQMON.

connection_down.label: Connection down
connection_down.description: The last test of a SAP system or destination failed.

no_workers.label: No workers
no_workers.description: Runs are queued and no active worker can take them.

rules.name: Name
rules.deleteMessage: Its open alerts are closed and its channels stop receiving its notices.

channels.empty: No channels: create one to receive notices.
channels.name: Name
channels.teamsHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
channels.hmacHint: At least 16 characters. Each notice carries the X-SX-Signature header.
channels.minSeverityHint: The channel receives every rule from this severity; you can refine it later.
channels.deleteMessage: It stops receiving notices and its credentials are deleted.
